================
File: app/api/send-form/route.ts
================
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { Resend } from 'resend';
const resend = new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY);
const recipientEmail = process.env.EMAIL_RECIPIENT;
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    if (!recipientEmail) {
      throw new Error('Recipient email is not configured.');
    }
    const body = await request.json();
    const { formType, message } = body;
    const { data, error } = await resend.emails.send({
      from: 'Someplace Social <onboarding@resend.dev>',
      to: recipientEmail,
      subject: `New Form Submission: ${formType}`,
      text: message,
    });
    if (error) {
      console.error('Resend error:', error);
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, message: 'Error sending email.' }, { status: 500 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: 'Form submitted successfully.' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error processing form:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, message: 'Server error.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

File: app/components/Accordion.tsx
================
"use client";
import { useState } from 'react';
import styles from './Accordion.module.css';
type AccordionProps = {
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
};
export default function Accordion({ title, children }: AccordionProps) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div>
      <div className={styles.header} onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}>
        {title}
        <span className={`${styles.icon} ${isOpen ? styles.iconOpen : ''}`}>
          ▼
        </span>
      </div>
      {isOpen && <div className={styles.content}>{children}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: app/components/ContactForm.tsx
================
"use client";
import { useState } from 'react';
import styles from './ContactForm.module.css';
type ContactFormProps = {
  formType: string;
  fields: readonly { name: string; label: string; placeholder?: string; type: 'text' | 'email' | 'textarea'; required: boolean }[];
};
export default function ContactForm({ formType, fields }: ContactFormProps) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const handleSubmit = async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setStatus('Submitting...');
    const formData = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    let message = '';
    formData.forEach((value, key) => {
      message += `${key}: ${value}\n`;
    });
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/send-form', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ formType, message }),
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (result.success) {
        setStatus('Message sent successfully!');
        (event.target as HTMLFormElement).reset();
      } else {
        setStatus('Failed to send message. Please try again.');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setStatus('An error occurred. Please try again.');
    }
  };
  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className={styles.form}>
      {fields.map(field => (
        <div key={field.name} className={styles.field}>
          <label htmlFor={field.name}>{field.label}</label>
          {field.type === 'textarea' ? (
            <textarea
              id={field.name}
              name={field.name}
              required={field.required}
              placeholder={field.placeholder || ''}
              className={styles.textarea}
            />
          ) : (
            <input
              type={field.type}
              id={field.name}
              name={field.name}
              required={field.required}
              placeholder={field.placeholder || ''}
              className={styles.input}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
      <button type="submit" className={styles.button}>Send Message</button>
      {status && <p>{status}</p>}
    </form>
  );
}

File: app/components/GoogleAnalytics.tsx

'use client';
import Script from 'next/script';
export default function GoogleAnalytics({ gaId }: { gaId: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Script
        src={`https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=${gaId}`}
        strategy="afterInteractive"
      />
      <Script id="google-analytics" strategy="afterInteractive">
        {`
          window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
          function gtag(){dataLayer.push(arguments);}
          gtag('js', new Date());
          gtag('config', '${gaId}');
        `}
      </Script>
    </>
  );
}

import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next';
export default function robots(): MetadataRoute.Robots {
  return {
    rules: {
      userAgent: '*',
      allow: '/',
      disallow: ['/api/'],
    },
    sitemap: 'https://www.someplacesocial.org/sitemap.xml',
  };
}

File: app/sitemap.ts
================
import type { MetadataRoute } from 'next';
import { getAllCitySlugs } from './lib/cities';
export default function sitemap(): MetadataRoute.Sitemap {
  const baseUrl = 'https://www.someplacesocial.org';
  const cityUrls = getAllCitySlugs().map((slug) => ({
    url: `${baseUrl}/events/${slug}`,
    lastModified: new Date(),
    changeFrequency: 'daily' as const,
    priority: 0.9,
  }));
  return [
    {
      url: baseUrl,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'weekly' as const,
      priority: 1.0,
    },
    ...cityUrls,
    {
      url: `${baseUrl}/contact`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'monthly' as const,
      priority: 0.7,
    },
    {
      url: `${baseUrl}/support`,
      lastModified: new Date(),
      changeFrequency: 'monthly' as const,
      priority: 0.5,
    },
  ];
}

================
File: app/events/components/DayPicker.tsx
================
'use client';
import { memo } from 'react';
import styles from '../EventsView.module.css';
const DAY_NAMES_SHORT = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'];
interface DayPickerProps {
  rollingWeek: Date[];
  activeDayIdx: number;
  onSelectDay: (idx: number) => void;
  dayCounts?: number[];
  getEventCountForDay?: (idx: number) => number;
}
function DayPicker({
  rollingWeek,
  activeDayIdx,
  onSelectDay,
  dayCounts,
  getEventCountForDay,
}: DayPickerProps) {
  const getCount = (idx: number) => {
    if (dayCounts && dayCounts[idx] !== undefined) {
      return dayCounts[idx];
    }
    return getEventCountForDay ? getEventCountForDay(idx) : 0;
  };
  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.dayListVertical} role="group" aria-label="Day list">
        {rollingWeek.map((day, idx) => {
          const label =
            idx === 0
              ? 'Today'
              : `${DAY_NAMES_SHORT[day.getDay()]} ${day.getDate()}`;
          const count = getCount(idx);
          const isSelected = idx === activeDayIdx;
          return (
            <button
              key={idx}
              type="button"
              className={`${styles.dayBtnVertical} ${
                isSelected ? styles.dayBtnVerticalActive : ''
              }`}
              aria-pressed={isSelected}
              onClick={() => onSelectDay(idx)}
            >
              <span>{label}</span>
              <span
                className={`${styles.dayCountText} ${
                  isSelected ? styles.dayCountTextActive : ''
                }`}
              >
                {count} events
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.mobileDaysGrid} role="group" aria-label="Pick day">
        {rollingWeek.map((day, idx) => {
          const dayShort = idx === 0 ? 'Today' : DAY_NAMES_SHORT[day.getDay()];
          const count = getCount(idx);
          const isSelected = idx === activeDayIdx;
          return (
            <button
              key={idx}
              type="button"
              className={`${styles.mobileDayBtn} ${
                isSelected ? styles.mobileDayBtnActive : ''
              }`}
              aria-pressed={isSelected}
              onClick={() => onSelectDay(idx)}
            >
              <span
                className={`${styles.mobileDayLabel} ${
                  isSelected ? styles.mobileDayLabelActive : ''
                }`}
              >
                {dayShort}
              </span>
              <span className={styles.mobileDayNum}>{day.getDate()}</span>
              <span
                className={`${styles.mobileDayCount} ${
                  isSelected ? styles.mobileDayCountActive : ''
                }`}
              >
                {count}
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
export default memo(DayPicker);

================
File: app/events/components/FilterDropdown.tsx
================
'use client';
import styles from './FilterControls.module.css';
interface FilterDropdownProps {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  category: string;
  value: string;
  title: string;
  options: string[];
  selected: string[];
  isOpen: boolean;
  onToggleOpen: () => void;
  onToggleOption: (option: string) => void;
  onClear: () => void;
  containerRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  flexStyle?: boolean;
}
export default function FilterDropdown({
  icon,
  category,
  value,
  title,
  options,
  selected,
  isOpen,
  onToggleOpen,
  onToggleOption,
  onClear,
  containerRef,
  flexStyle = false,
}: FilterDropdownProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={styles.multiSelectWrapper}
      ref={containerRef}
      style={flexStyle ? { flex: 1 } : undefined}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        className={`${styles.multiSelectTrigger} ${
          selected.length > 0 ? styles.multiSelectTriggerActive : ''
        }`}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        onClick={onToggleOpen}
      >
        <span className={styles.filterTriggerLeft}>
          <span className={styles.filterTriggerIcon}>{icon}</span>
          <span className={styles.filterCategory}>{category}</span>
          <span className={styles.filterValue}>{value}</span>
        </span>
        <svg
          className={styles.filterChevron}
          width="14"
          height="14"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="2.4"
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path d={isOpen ? 'M6 15l6-6 6 6' : 'M6 9l6 6 6-6'} />
        </svg>
      </button>
      {isOpen && (
        <div className={styles.multiSelectMenu}>
          <div className={styles.multiSelectMenuHeader}>
            <span>{title}</span>
            {selected.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className={styles.multiSelectClearLink}
                onClick={onClear}
              >
                Clear
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          {options.map((opt) => {
            const isChecked = selected.includes(opt);
            return (
              <label key={opt} className={styles.multiSelectOption}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={isChecked}
                  onChange={() => onToggleOption(opt)}
                  className={styles.hiddenCheckbox}
                />
                <span
                  className={`${styles.customCheckbox} ${
                    isChecked ? styles.customCheckboxChecked : ''
                  }`}
                >
                  {isChecked && (
                    <svg
                      width="12"
                      height="12"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                      fill="none"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      strokeWidth="3"
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                    >
                      <path d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
                    </svg>
                  )}
                </span>
                <span>{opt}</span>
              </label>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: app/contact/ContactView.tsx

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import styles from './Contact.module.css';
const DAYS_OF_WEEK = [
  { id: 'mon', label: 'Mon' },
  { id: 'tue', label: 'Tue' },
  { id: 'wed', label: 'Wed' },
  { id: 'thu', label: 'Thu' },
  { id: 'fri', label: 'Fri' },
  { id: 'sat', label: 'Sat' },
  { id: 'sun', label: 'Sun' },
] as const;
const PRE_REGISTRATION_OPTIONS = [
  'Drop-in (no RSVP needed)',
  'RSVP recommended',
  'RSVP required',
  'Ticketed / pre-pay',
] as const;
export default function ContactView() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const initialTab = searchParams.get('tab') === 'question' ? 'question' : 'submit';
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'submit' | 'question'>(initialTab);
  const [city, setCity] = useState('Medellín, Colombia');
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [organizer, setOrganizer] = useState('');
  const [activity, setActivity] = useState('');
  const [otherActivities, setOtherActivities] = useState('');
  const [about, setAbout] = useState('');
  // Section 2: When & Schedule
  const [frequency, setFrequency] = useState('Weekly');
  const [frequencyNotes, setFrequencyNotes] = useState('');
  const [selectedDays, setSelectedDays] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [startTime, setStartTime] = useState('');
  const [endTime, setEndTime] = useState('');
  // Section 3: Where / Location
  const [venue, setVenue] = useState('');
  const [location, setLocation] = useState('');
  const [area, setArea] = useState('');
  const [map, setMap] = useState('');
  // Section 4: Cost & Pre-Registration
  const [price, setPrice] = useState('');
  const [preRegistrationType, setPreRegistrationType] = useState('Drop-in (no RSVP needed)');
  const [preRegistrationDetails, setPreRegistrationDetails] = useState('');
  // Section 5: Links & Contact
  const [website, setWebsite] = useState('');
  const [social, setSocial] = useState('');
  const [contact, setContact] = useState('');
  // Section 6: Submitter Info & Notes
  const [submitterName, setSubmitterName] = useState('');
  const [submitterEmail, setSubmitterEmail] = useState('');
  const [isOrganizer, setIsOrganizer] = useState(false);
  const [adminNotes, setAdminNotes] = useState('');
  // Status states
  const [submitLoading, setSubmitLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitStatus, setSubmitStatus] = useState<{ success: boolean; message: string } | null>(null);
  // Ask a question tab states
  const [questionFirstName, setQuestionFirstName] = useState('');
  const [questionEmail, setQuestionEmail] = useState('');
  const [questionMessage, setQuestionMessage] = useState('');
  const [questionLoading, setQuestionLoading] = useState(false);
  const [questionStatus, setQuestionStatus] = useState<{ success: boolean; message: string } | null>(null);
  const toggleDay = (dayLabel: string) => {
    setSelectedDays((prev) =>
      prev.includes(dayLabel) ? prev.filter((d) => d !== dayLabel) : [...prev, dayLabel]
    );
  };
  const handleEventSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitLoading(true);
    setSubmitStatus(null);
    // Compute unified activity text
    const fullActivity = otherActivities.trim()
      ? activity === 'Other'
        ? otherActivities.trim()
        : `${activity ? `${activity}, ` : ''}${otherActivities.trim()}`
      : activity || 'Not specified';
    const fullPreRegistration = preRegistrationDetails.trim()
      ? `${preRegistrationType} - ${preRegistrationDetails.trim()}`
      : preRegistrationType;
    const daysText = selectedDays.length > 0 ? selectedDays.join(', ') : '';
    // Build structured human-readable summary
    const summaryLines = [
      `=== EVENT SUBMISSION ===`,
      `City: ${city}`,
      `Title: ${title}`,
      `Venue: ${venue || 'Not specified'}`,
      `Location / Address: ${location || 'Not specified'}`,
      `Area / Neighborhood: ${area || 'Not specified'}`,
      `Activity: ${fullActivity}`,
      `Day of Week: ${daysText || 'Not specified'}`,
      `Start Time: ${startTime || 'Not specified'}`,
      `End Time: ${endTime || 'Not specified'}`,
      `Frequency: ${frequency}`,
      frequencyNotes ? `Frequency Notes: ${frequencyNotes}` : null,
      `Price: ${price || 'Not specified'}`,
      `Pre-Registration: ${fullPreRegistration}`,
      map ? `Google Maps Link: ${map}` : null,
      social ? `Social Media: ${social}` : null,
      website ? `Website: ${website}` : null,
      contact ? `Contact (Email / Phone / WhatsApp / Form): ${contact}` : null,
      about ? `About / Description:\n${about}` : null,
      ``,
      `=== SUBMITTER INFO ===`,
      `Submitter Name: ${submitterName || 'Anonymous / Not provided'}`,
      `Submitter Email: ${submitterEmail || 'Not provided'}`,
      `Is Event Host/Organizer: ${isOrganizer ? 'Yes' : 'No (Community member)'}`,
      adminNotes ? `Notes for Admin:\n${adminNotes}` : null,
      ``,
      `=== COPY-PASTE GOOGLE SHEET ROW (TSV) ===`,
      `Title\tVenue\tLocation\tArea\tActivity\tDay of Week\tStart Time\tEnd Time\tFrequency\tFrequency Notes\tPrice\tPre-Registration\tMap\tSocial\tWebsite\tContact\tAbout`,
      [
        title.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        venue.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        location.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        area.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        fullActivity.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        daysText.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        startTime.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        endTime.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        frequency.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        frequencyNotes.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        price.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        fullPreRegistration.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        map.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        social.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        website.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        contact.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
        about.replace(/[\t\r\n]+/g, ' '),
      ].join('\t'),
    ].filter(Boolean);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/send-form', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          formType: `Submit an Event (${city})`,
          message: summaryLines.join('\n'),
        }),
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (result.success) {
        setSubmitStatus({
          success: true,
          message: 'Thank you! Your event submission has been sent. We will review and add it shortly.',
        });
        setTitle('');
        setOrganizer('');
        setActivity('');
        setOtherActivities('');
        setAbout('');
        setFrequency('Weekly');
        setFrequencyNotes('');
        setSelectedDays([]);
        setStartTime('');
        setEndTime('');
        setVenue('');
        setLocation('');
        setArea('');
        setMap('');
        setPrice('');
        setPreRegistrationType('Drop-in (no RSVP needed)');
        setPreRegistrationDetails('');
        setWebsite('');
        setSocial('');
        setContact('');
        setSubmitterName('');
        setSubmitterEmail('');
        setIsOrganizer(false);
        setAdminNotes('');
      } else {
        setSubmitStatus({
          success: false,
          message: 'Failed to submit event. Please try again.',
        });
      }
    } catch {
      setSubmitStatus({
        success: false,
        message: 'A connection error occurred. Please try again.',
      });
    } finally {
      setSubmitLoading(false);
    }
  };
  const handleQuestionSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setQuestionLoading(true);
    setQuestionStatus(null);
    const messageLines = [
      `First Name: ${questionFirstName}`,
      `Email Address: ${questionEmail}`,
      `Message:`,
      questionMessage,
    ];
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/send-form', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          formType: 'Ask a Question',
          message: messageLines.join('\n'),
        }),
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (result.success) {
        setQuestionStatus({
          success: true,
          message: 'Thank you! Your message has been sent. We will get back to you soon.',
        });
        setQuestionFirstName('');
        setQuestionEmail('');
        setQuestionMessage('');
      } else {
        setQuestionStatus({
          success: false,
          message: 'Failed to send message. Please try again.',
        });
      }
    } catch {
      setQuestionStatus({
        success: false,
        message: 'A connection error occurred. Please try again.',
      });
    } finally {
      setQuestionLoading(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <main className={styles.page}>
      <section className={styles.hero}>
        <div>
          <h1 className={styles.heroTitle}>Contact Us</h1>
          <p className={styles.heroDescription}>
            Have an event to share or a question for us? Use the forms below and we&apos;ll get back to you.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.heroImageContainer}>
          <Image
            src="/images/hero-contact.png"
            alt="Illustration of a capybara drinking coffee"
            width={340}
            height={260}
            priority
            className={styles.heroImage}
          />
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className={styles.thanks}>
        <h2 className={styles.thanksTitle}>Thanks for contributing</h2>
        <p className={styles.thanksText}>
          Free for everyone — no ads, no pop-ups. It runs 100% on donations. If you&apos;re able,{' '}
          <a
            href="https://buymeacoffee.com/someplacesocial"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className={styles.drinkLink}
          >
            buy me a drink
          </a>.
        </p>
      </section>
      <div className={styles.labelDivider}>
        <span>Get in touch</span>
        <div className={styles.labelLine} aria-hidden="true" />
      </div>
      <section className={styles.panel}>
        <div className={styles.tabs} role="tablist" aria-label="Contact options">
          <button
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            id="tab-submit"
            aria-selected={activeTab === 'submit'}
            aria-controls="panel-submit"
            className={`${styles.tabBtn} ${activeTab === 'submit' ? styles.tabBtnActive : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('submit')}
          >
            Submit an event
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            role="tab"
            id="tab-question"
            aria-selected={activeTab === 'question'}
            aria-controls="panel-question"
            className={`${styles.tabBtn} ${activeTab === 'question' ? styles.tabBtnActive : ''}`}
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('question')}
          >
            Ask a question
          </button>
        </div>
        {activeTab === 'submit' ? (
          <form
            id="panel-submit"
            role="tabpanel"
            aria-labelledby="tab-submit"
            onSubmit={handleEventSubmit}
          >
            <div className={styles.criteria}>
              <h3 className={styles.criteriaHeading}>Event listing criteria</h3>
              <ul className={styles.criteriaGrid}>
                <li className={styles.criteriaItem}>
                  <strong>Regularly occurring:</strong> weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly.
                </li>
                <li className={styles.criteriaItem}>
                  <strong>Group event:</strong> open to multiple people, no one-on-one.
                </li>
                <li className={styles.criteriaItem}>
                  <strong>Open:</strong> inclusive and open to all.
                </li>
                <li className={styles.criteriaItem}>
                  <strong>Affordable:</strong> free, donation, or reasonably priced.
                </li>
              </ul>
              <p className={styles.criteriaFootnote}>
                Only the <strong>event title</strong> is required. Don&apos;t worry if you don&apos;t know all details — share whatever you know!
              </p>
            </div>
            {}
            <fieldset className={styles.fieldset}>
              <legend className={styles.legend}>The Event</legend>
              <p className={styles.sectionDescription}>
                Basic details about the event.
              </p>
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-city" className={styles.label}>
                    City / Region
                  </label>
                  <select
                    id="submit-city"
                    value={city}
                    onChange={(e) => setCity(e.target.value)}
                    className={styles.select}
                  >
                    <option value="Medellín, Colombia">Medellín, Colombia</option>
                    <option value="Fort Collins, Colorado">Fort Collins, Colorado</option>
                    <option value="Other / New City">Other / New City</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-title" className={styles.label}>
                    Event Title *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-title"
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={title}
                    onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Verb &amp; Vibe Game Nite"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                  <span className={styles.helperText}>The only required field!</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-organizer" className={styles.label}>
                    Organizer / Host
                    <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-organizer"
                    type="text"
                    value={organizer}
                    onChange={(e) => setOrganizer(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Life Dance Studios, English Club"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-activity" className={styles.label}>
                    Activity / Category
                    <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <select
                    id="submit-activity"
                    value={activity}
                    onChange={(e) => setActivity(e.target.value)}
                    className={styles.select}
                  >
                    <option value="">Select an activity…</option>
                    <option value="Language exchange">Language exchange</option>
                    <option value="Dance">Dance (Salsa, Bachata, etc.)</option>
                    <option value="Games">Games &amp; Trivia</option>
                    <option value="Music">Live Music &amp; Jam</option>
                    <option value="Social">Social &amp; Drinks</option>
                    <option value="Fitness">Fitness, Sports &amp; Yoga</option>
                    <option value="Art & Craft">Art &amp; Crafts</option>
                    <option value="Other">Other</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
              {activity === 'Other' && (
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-other-act" className={styles.label}>
                    Describe the activity
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-other-act"
                    type="text"
                    value={otherActivities}
                    onChange={(e) => setOtherActivities(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Book club, Coding meetup, Chess"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
              )}
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <label htmlFor="submit-about" className={styles.label}>
                  About the event
                  <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="submit-about"
                  value={about}
                  onChange={(e) => setAbout(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="What is this event about? What can people expect when they arrive?"
                  className={styles.textarea}
                />
              </div>
            </fieldset>
            {}
            <fieldset className={styles.fieldset}>
              <legend className={styles.legend}>When &amp; Schedule</legend>
              <p className={styles.sectionDescription}>
                Help people know when to show up.
              </p>
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-frequency" className={styles.label}>
                    How often does it happen?
                  </label>
                  <select
                    id="submit-frequency"
                    value={frequency}
                    onChange={(e) => setFrequency(e.target.value)}
                    className={styles.select}
                  >
                    <option value="Weekly">Weekly</option>
                    <option value="Bi-weekly">Bi-weekly (every two weeks)</option>
                    <option value="Monthly (1st Tuesday…)">Monthly (e.g. 1st Tuesday)</option>
                    <option value="Seasonal / Irregular">Seasonal / Irregular</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-freq-notes" className={styles.label}>
                    Frequency notes
                    <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-freq-notes"
                    type="text"
                    value={frequencyNotes}
                    onChange={(e) => setFrequencyNotes(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. 1st &amp; 3rd Friday of each month, May–Sep only"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <span className={styles.label}>
                  Day of week <span className={styles.labelSub}>(select all that apply)</span>
                </span>
                <div className={styles.days}>
                  {DAYS_OF_WEEK.map((day) => {
                    const isChecked = selectedDays.includes(day.label);
                    return (
                      <label
                        key={day.id}
                        className={`${styles.dayPill} ${isChecked ? styles.dayPillActive : ''}`}
                      >
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={isChecked}
                          onChange={() => toggleDay(day.label)}
                          className={styles.dayCheckbox}
                        />
                        {day.label}
                      </label>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-start-time" className={styles.label}>
                    Start time
                    <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-start-time"
                    type="text"
                    value={startTime}
                    onChange={(e) => setStartTime(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. 7:00 PM"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-end-time" className={styles.label}>
                    End time
                    <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-end-time"
                    type="text"
                    value={endTime}
                    onChange={(e) => setEndTime(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. 9:30 PM"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </fieldset>
            {}
            <fieldset className={styles.fieldset}>
              <legend className={styles.legend}>Where / Location</legend>
              <p className={styles.sectionDescription}>
                Where does the event take place?
              </p>
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-venue" className={styles.label}>
                    Venue name
                    <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-venue"
                    type="text"
                    value={venue}
                    onChange={(e) => setVenue(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Café Revolución, Washington Park"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                  <span className={styles.helperText}>Name of the café, bar, studio, or park</span>
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-area" className={styles.label}>
                    Neighborhood / Area
                    <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-area"
                    type="text"
                    value={area}
                    onChange={(e) => setArea(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Laureles, Poblado, Old Town"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-location" className={styles.label}>
                    Address / Specific location
                    <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-location"
                    type="text"
                    value={location}
                    onChange={(e) => setLocation(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Cra. 37 #8A-37, 2nd floor"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-map" className={styles.label}>
                    Google Maps link
                    <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-map"
                    type="text"
                    value={map}
                    onChange={(e) => setMap(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. maps.app.goo.gl/…"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </fieldset>
            {}
            <fieldset className={styles.fieldset}>
              <legend className={styles.legend}>Cost &amp; Pre-Registration</legend>
              <p className={styles.sectionDescription}>
                Is it free, paid, or does it require signing up in advance?
              </p>
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <label htmlFor="submit-price" className={styles.label}>
                  Price
                  <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  id="submit-price"
                  type="text"
                  value={price}
                  onChange={(e) => setPrice(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Free, Donation, $10, or 15k COP"
                  className={styles.input}
                />
              </div>
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <span className={styles.label}>Pre-Registration / RSVP</span>
                <div className={styles.radioGroup}>
                  {PRE_REGISTRATION_OPTIONS.map((opt) => {
                    const isSelected = preRegistrationType === opt;
                    return (
                      <label
                        key={opt}
                        className={`${styles.radioPill} ${isSelected ? styles.radioPillActive : ''}`}
                      >
                        <input
                          type="radio"
                          name="preRegistrationType"
                          value={opt}
                          checked={isSelected}
                          onChange={(e) => setPreRegistrationType(e.target.value)}
                          className={styles.radioInput}
                        />
                        {opt}
                      </label>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <label htmlFor="submit-prereg-details" className={styles.label}>
                  Registration link or instructions
                  <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  id="submit-prereg-details"
                  type="text"
                  value={preRegistrationDetails}
                  onChange={(e) => setPreRegistrationDetails(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. eventbrite.com/... or DM @account on Instagram"
                  className={styles.input}
                />
              </div>
            </fieldset>
            {}
            <fieldset className={styles.fieldset}>
              <legend className={styles.legend}>
                Links &amp; Contact <span className={styles.legendOptional}>(optional)</span>
              </legend>
              <p className={styles.sectionDescription}>
                How people can find more information or reach out to the organizer.
              </p>
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-website" className={styles.label}>
                    Website link
                    <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-website"
                    type="text"
                    value={website}
                    onChange={(e) => setWebsite(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. somedomain.com/event"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-social" className={styles.label}>
                    Social media / Instagram
                    <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-social"
                    type="text"
                    value={social}
                    onChange={(e) => setSocial(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. instagram.com/ourgroup or @ourgroup"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <label htmlFor="submit-contact" className={styles.label}>
                  Organizer contact
                  <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                </label>
                <input
                  id="submit-contact"
                  type="text"
                  value={contact}
                  onChange={(e) => setContact(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. organizer@gmail.com, +57 300 123 4567, or WhatsApp / form link"
                  className={styles.input}
                />
                <span className={styles.helperText}>
                  Can be an email address, phone number, WhatsApp link, or web contact form.
                </span>
              </div>
            </fieldset>
            {}
            <fieldset className={styles.fieldset}>
              <legend className={styles.legend}>
                About You <span className={styles.legendOptional}>(optional)</span>
              </legend>
              <p className={styles.sectionDescription}>
                Let us know who is submitting in case we have a question before publishing.
              </p>
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-name" className={styles.label}>
                    Your name
                    <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-name"
                    type="text"
                    value={submitterName}
                    onChange={(e) => setSubmitterName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Alex Rivera"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="submit-email" className={styles.label}>
                    Your email address
                    <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="submit-email"
                    type="email"
                    value={submitterEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => setSubmitterEmail(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. alex@gmail.com"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <label className={styles.checkboxContainer}>
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={isOrganizer}
                    onChange={(e) => setIsOrganizer(e.target.checked)}
                    className={styles.checkboxCustom}
                  />
                  <span className={styles.checkboxLabelText}>
                    I am the organizer or host of this event
                  </span>
                </label>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <label htmlFor="submit-admin-notes" className={styles.label}>
                  Note for administrator
                  <span className={styles.labelSub}>(optional)</span>
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="submit-admin-notes"
                  value={adminNotes}
                  onChange={(e) => setAdminNotes(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Any extra context or private notes for us (e.g., 'Venue might change next month', 'Found this on Instagram')."
                  className={styles.textarea}
                />
              </div>
            </fieldset>
            <button type="submit" className={styles.submitBtn} disabled={submitLoading}>
              {submitLoading ? 'Submitting event...' : 'Submit event'}
            </button>
            {submitStatus && (
              <div
                className={`${styles.statusAlert} ${
                  submitStatus.success ? styles.statusSuccess : styles.statusError
                }`}
                role="status"
              >
                {submitStatus.message}
              </div>
            )}
          </form>
        ) : (
          <form
            id="panel-question"
            role="tabpanel"
            aria-labelledby="tab-question"
            onSubmit={handleQuestionSubmit}
          >
            <fieldset className={styles.fieldset}>
              <legend className={styles.legend}>Ask a question</legend>
              <div className={styles.row}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="q-first-name" className={styles.label}>
                    First name *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="q-first-name"
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={questionFirstName}
                    onChange={(e) => setQuestionFirstName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. John"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <label htmlFor="q-email" className={styles.label}>
                    Email address *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    id="q-email"
                    type="email"
                    required
                    value={questionEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => setQuestionEmail(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. john@doe.com"
                    className={styles.input}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <label htmlFor="q-message" className={styles.label}>
                  Message *
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="q-message"
                  required
                  value={questionMessage}
                  onChange={(e) => setQuestionMessage(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Enter your message…"
                  className={styles.textarea}
                />
              </div>
            </fieldset>
            <button type="submit" className={styles.submitBtn} disabled={questionLoading}>
              {questionLoading ? 'Sending message...' : 'Send message'}
            </button>
            {questionStatus && (
              <div
                className={`${styles.statusAlert} ${
                  questionStatus.success ? styles.statusSuccess : styles.statusError
                }`}
                role="status"
              >
                {questionStatus.message}
              </div>
            )}
          </form>
        )}
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

File: app/events/components/CityHeroCard.tsx

'use client';
import styles from './CityHeroCard.module.css';
interface CityHeroCardProps {
  cityName: string;
  introTitle?: string;
  introDescription?: string;
  eventCount?: number;
  activities: string[];
  selectedActivities: string[];
  onSelectChip: (activity: string) => void;
  onClearActivities: () => void;
}
export default function CityHeroCard({
  cityName,
  introTitle,
  introDescription,
  eventCount,
  activities,
  selectedActivities,
  onSelectChip,
  onClearActivities,
}: CityHeroCardProps) {
  const isAllActive = selectedActivities.length === 0;
  return (
    <section className={styles.heroCard} aria-labelledby="city-intro-heading">
      <div className={styles.titleCol}>
        <p className={styles.eyebrow}>Someplace Social</p>
        <h1 id="city-intro-heading" className={styles.title}>
          {introTitle || `${cityName} Community Listings`}
        </h1>
        {typeof eventCount === 'number' && eventCount > 0 && (
          <div className={styles.metaSubtitle}>
            {eventCount} {eventCount === 1 ? 'event & activity' : 'events & activities'}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.descCol}>
        <p className={styles.lead}>
          {introDescription ||
            `Community supported events, group activities, and weekly classes all in one place. Find weekly meetups, classes, and fun stuff to do in ${cityName}.`}
        </p>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.chips} role="group" aria-label="Filter by activity">
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`${styles.chip} ${isAllActive ? styles.chipActive : ''}`}
          aria-pressed={isAllActive}
          onClick={onClearActivities}
        >
          All
        </button>
        {activities.map((act) => {
          const isSelected = selectedActivities.includes(act);
          return (
            <button
              key={act}
              type="button"
              className={`${styles.chip} ${isSelected ? styles.chipActive : ''}`}
              aria-pressed={isSelected}
              onClick={() => onSelectChip(act)}
            >
              {act}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { CityPriceConfig } from '../../lib/cities';
import { formatPriceValue, formatPriceReadout } from '../utils';
import styles from './FilterControls.module.css';
interface PriceFilterDropdownProps {
  priceConfig: CityPriceConfig;
  maxPrice: number;
  onPriceChange: (val: number) => void;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onToggleOpen: () => void;
  containerRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  flexStyle?: boolean;
}
export default function PriceFilterDropdown({
  priceConfig,
  maxPrice,
  onPriceChange,
  isOpen,
  onToggleOpen,
  containerRef,
  flexStyle = false,
}: PriceFilterDropdownProps) {
  const isFreeActive = maxPrice === 0;
  const isUnderActive = maxPrice === priceConfig.underValue;
  const isFiltered = maxPrice < priceConfig.maxPrice;
  const priceValue = useMemo(() => {
    if (maxPrice >= priceConfig.maxPrice) return 'All';
    if (maxPrice === 0) return 'Free';
    if (maxPrice === priceConfig.underValue) return priceConfig.underLabel;
    return `Up to ${formatPriceValue(maxPrice, priceConfig)}`;
  }, [maxPrice, priceConfig]);
  const readoutText = useMemo(() => {
    return formatPriceReadout(maxPrice, priceConfig);
  }, [maxPrice, priceConfig]);
  const readoutColor = isFreeActive ? '#1F7A4D' : '#1F1A14';
  const trackFill = isFreeActive ? '#1F7A4D' : '#1F1A14';
  const trackPercent = (maxPrice / priceConfig.maxPrice) * 100;
  const handleToggleFree = () => {
    onPriceChange(isFreeActive ? priceConfig.maxPrice : 0);
  };
  const handleToggleUnder = () => {
    onPriceChange(isUnderActive ? priceConfig.maxPrice : priceConfig.underValue);
  };
  return (
    <div
      className={styles.multiSelectWrapper}
      ref={containerRef}
      style={flexStyle ? { flex: 1, minWidth: 120 } : undefined}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        className={`${styles.multiSelectTrigger} ${
          isFiltered ? styles.multiSelectTriggerActive : ''
        }`}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        onClick={onToggleOpen}
      >
        <span className={styles.filterTriggerLeft}>
          <span className={styles.filterTriggerIcon}>
            <svg
              width="16"
              height="16"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2.2"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              <path d="M20.6 13.4l-7.2 7.2a2 2 0 0 1-2.8 0L3 13V3h10l7.6 7.6a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.8z" />
              <circle cx="7.5" cy="7.5" r="1.2" fill="currentColor" />
            </svg>
          </span>
          <span className={styles.filterCategory}>Price</span>
          <span className={styles.filterValue}>{priceValue}</span>
        </span>
        <svg
          className={styles.filterChevron}
          width="14"
          height="14"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="2.4"
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path d={isOpen ? 'M6 15l6-6 6 6' : 'M6 9l6 6 6-6'} />
        </svg>
      </button>
      {isOpen && (
        <div className={`${styles.priceMenu} ${flexStyle ? styles.mobilePriceMenu : ''}`}>
          <div className={styles.priceHeaderRow}>
            <span className={styles.priceHeaderTitle}>Price</span>
            <span
              className={styles.priceHeaderReadout}
              style={{ color: readoutColor }}
            >
              {readoutText}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.priceChipsRow} role="group" aria-label="Price quick filters">
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`${styles.priceChip} ${
                isFreeActive ? styles.priceChipFreeActive : ''
              }`}
              onClick={handleToggleFree}
              aria-pressed={isFreeActive}
            >
              <svg
                width="15"
                height="15"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <path d="M20.6 13.4l-7.2 7.2a2 2 0 0 1-2.8 0L3 13V3h10l7.6 7.6a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.8z" />
                <circle cx="7.5" cy="7.5" r="1.2" fill="currentColor" />
              </svg>
              Free / donation
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={`${styles.priceChip} ${
                isUnderActive ? styles.priceChipUnderActive : ''
              }`}
              onClick={handleToggleUnder}
              aria-pressed={isUnderActive}
            >
              {priceConfig.underLabel}
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.sliderSection}>
            <input
              type="range"
              min={0}
              max={priceConfig.maxPrice}
              step={priceConfig.step}
              value={maxPrice}
              onChange={(e) => onPriceChange(Number(e.target.value))}
              className={styles.rangeSlider}
              aria-label="Maximum price"
              style={{
                background: `linear-gradient(to right, ${trackFill} 0%, ${trackFill} ${trackPercent}%, #EADFC4 ${trackPercent}%, #EADFC4 100%)`,
              }}
            />
            <div className={styles.sliderLabelsRow} aria-hidden="true">
              <span>Free</span>
              <span>{priceConfig.midLabel}</span>
              <span>Any</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: app/events/[city]/page.tsx
================
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { getCityBySlug, getAllCitySlugs } from '../../lib/cities';
import { getEvents } from '../../lib/google-sheets';
import CityEventsView from '../CityEventsView';
export const revalidate = 3600;
type PageProps = {
  params: Promise<{ city: string }>;
};
export async function generateStaticParams() {
  return getAllCitySlugs().map((city) => ({ city }));
}
export async function generateMetadata({ params }: PageProps): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { city: citySlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    return {
      title: 'City Not Found · Someplace Social',
      robots: { index: false, follow: false },
    };
  }
  const title = `${city.name} Events & Activities This Week`;
  const description = `Weekly community events, classes, and social activities in ${city.heroLocation}. Free and affordable group gatherings.`;
  return {
    title,
    description,
    alternates: {
      canonical: `/events/${city.slug}`,
    },
    openGraph: {
      title: `${title} | Someplace Social`,
      description,
      url: `/events/${city.slug}`,
      siteName: 'Someplace Social',
      type: 'website',
    },
    robots: {
      index: true,
      follow: true,
      googleBot: {
        index: true,
        follow: true,
      },
    },
  };
}
export default async function CityEventsPage({ params }: PageProps) {
  const { city: citySlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    notFound();
  }
  const events = await getEvents(city);
  const allSlugs = getAllCitySlugs();
  const countEntries = await Promise.all(
    allSlugs.map(async (slug) => {
      const c = getCityBySlug(slug);
      if (!c) return [slug, 0] as const;
      if (c.slug === city.slug) return [slug, events.length] as const;
      const otherEvents = await getEvents(c);
      return [slug, otherEvents.length] as const;
    })
  );
  const cityCounts = Object.fromEntries(countEntries);
  return (
    <CityEventsView
      city={city}
      initialEvents={events}
      initialCityCounts={cityCounts}
    />
  );
}

File: app/events/components/SuggestEditModal.tsx

'use client';
import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Event } from '../../lib/google-sheets';
import styles from './SuggestEditModal.module.css';
interface SuggestEditModalProps {
  event: Event;
  cityName: string;
  onClose: () => void;
}
interface FormValues {
  title: string;
  organization: string;
  venue: string;
  location: string;
  area: string;
  dayOfWeek: string;
  startTime: string;
  endTime: string;
  frequency: string;
  frequencyNotes: string;
  price: string;
  preRegistration: string;
  map: string;
  website: string;
  social: string;
}
const FIELD_LABELS: Record<keyof FormValues, string> = {
  title: 'Event Title',
  organization: 'Organizer / Host',
  venue: 'Venue',
  location: 'Address / Location',
  area: 'Neighborhood / Area',
  dayOfWeek: 'Day of Week',
  startTime: 'Start Time',
  endTime: 'End Time',
  frequency: 'Frequency',
  frequencyNotes: 'Frequency Notes',
  price: 'Price',
  preRegistration: 'Pre-Registration',
  map: 'Google Maps Link',
  website: 'Website',
  social: 'Social Media / Instagram',
};
export default function SuggestEditModal({
  event,
  cityName,
  onClose,
}: SuggestEditModalProps) {
  const initialValues: FormValues = useMemo(
    () => ({
      title: event.title || '',
      organization: event.organization || '',
      venue: event.venue || event.location || '',
      location: event.location || '',
      area: event.area || '',
      dayOfWeek: event.dayOfWeek || '',
      startTime: event.startTime || '',
      endTime: event.endTime || '',
      frequency: event.frequency || '',
      frequencyNotes: event.frequencyNotes || '',
      price: event.price || '',
      preRegistration: event.preRegistration || '',
      map: event.map || '',
      website: event.website || '',
      social: event.social || '',
    }),
    [event]
  );
  const [values, setValues] = useState<FormValues>(initialValues);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ success: boolean; message: string } | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    function handleKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && !isSubmitting) {
        onClose();
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [onClose, isSubmitting]);
  const handleChange = (key: keyof FormValues, val: string) => {
    setValues((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: val }));
  };
  const changedFields = useMemo(() => {
    const diffs: {
      key: keyof FormValues;
      label: string;
      original: string;
      updated: string;
    }[] = [];
    (Object.keys(initialValues) as (keyof FormValues)[]).forEach((key) => {
      const orig = (initialValues[key] || '').trim();
      const curr = (values[key] || '').trim();
      if (orig !== curr) {
        diffs.push({
          key,
          label: FIELD_LABELS[key],
          original: orig || '(empty)',
          updated: curr || '(cleared)',
        });
      }
    });
    return diffs;
  }, [initialValues, values]);
  const hasChanges = changedFields.length > 0 || notes.trim().length > 0;
  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!hasChanges) return;
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setStatus(null);
    const messageLines: string[] = [
      `Event: ${event.title}`,
      `City: ${cityName}`,
      `Submitter Email: ${email.trim() || 'Not provided'}`,
      '',
    ];
    if (changedFields.length > 0) {
      messageLines.push(`EDITED FIELDS (${changedFields.length}):`);
      messageLines.push('────────────────────────────────────────');
      changedFields.forEach((diff) => {
        messageLines.push(`• ${diff.label}:`);
        messageLines.push(`    Original: ${diff.original}`);
        messageLines.push(`    Updated:  ${diff.updated}`);
      });
      messageLines.push('────────────────────────────────────────');
    } else {
      messageLines.push('No individual field changes detected.');
    }
    if (notes.trim()) {
      messageLines.push('');
      messageLines.push('Additional Notes / Context:');
      messageLines.push(notes.trim());
    }
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/send-form', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          formType: `Edit a Listing (${cityName})`,
          message: messageLines.join('\n'),
        }),
      });
      const res = await response.json();
      if (res.success) {
        setStatus({
          success: true,
          message: 'Thank you! Your suggested edits have been sent for review.',
        });
        setTimeout(onClose, 1800);
      } else {
        setStatus({
          success: false,
          message: 'Failed to send edit. Please try again.',
        });
      }
    } catch {
      setStatus({
        success: false,
        message: 'A connection error occurred. Please try again.',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };
  const isFieldChanged = (key: keyof FormValues) =>
    (initialValues[key] || '').trim() !== (values[key] || '').trim();
  return (
    <div className={styles.modalBackdrop} onClick={onClose}>
      <div
        className={styles.modalContent}
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="suggest-edit-title"
      >
        <div className={styles.modalHeader}>
          <div className={styles.modalTitleGroup}>
            <h2 id="suggest-edit-title" className={styles.modalTitle}>
              Suggest Edit
            </h2>
            <div className={styles.modalSubtitle}>
              {event.title} · {cityName}
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className={styles.modalCloseBtn}
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close modal"
            disabled={isSubmitting}
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className={styles.modalForm}>
          <div className={styles.modalScrollArea}>
            <div className={styles.infoBanner}>
              Section headers and original details are fixed below. Pre-filled fields are editable — only fields you change will be sent to the administrator.
            </div>
            <div className={styles.section}>
              <div className={styles.sectionHeader}>
                <span className={styles.sectionTitle}>Event Info</span>
                <div className={styles.sectionLine} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <div className={styles.gridRow}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <div className={styles.fieldHeader}>
                    <label htmlFor="edit-title" className={styles.label}>
                      Event Title
                    </label>
                    {isFieldChanged('title') && <span className={styles.changedBadge}>Edited</span>}
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="edit-title"
                    type="text"
                    value={values.title}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('title', e.target.value)}
                    className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('title') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <div className={styles.fieldHeader}>
                    <label htmlFor="edit-org" className={styles.label}>
                      Organizer / Host
                    </label>
                    {isFieldChanged('organization') && <span className={styles.changedBadge}>Edited</span>}
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="edit-org"
                    type="text"
                    value={values.organization}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('organization', e.target.value)}
                    className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('organization') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.section}>
              <div className={styles.sectionHeader}>
                <span className={styles.sectionTitle}>Venue &amp; Location</span>
                <div className={styles.sectionLine} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <div className={styles.gridRow}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <div className={styles.fieldHeader}>
                    <label htmlFor="edit-venue" className={styles.label}>
                      Venue
                    </label>
                    {isFieldChanged('venue') && <span className={styles.changedBadge}>Edited</span>}
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="edit-venue"
                    type="text"
                    value={values.venue}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('venue', e.target.value)}
                    className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('venue') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <div className={styles.fieldHeader}>
                    <label htmlFor="edit-area" className={styles.label}>
                      Neighborhood / Area
                    </label>
                    {isFieldChanged('area') && <span className={styles.changedBadge}>Edited</span>}
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="edit-area"
                    type="text"
                    value={values.area}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('area', e.target.value)}
                    className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('area') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <div className={styles.fieldHeader}>
                  <label htmlFor="edit-location" className={styles.label}>
                    Address / Full Location
                  </label>
                  {isFieldChanged('location') && <span className={styles.changedBadge}>Edited</span>}
                </div>
                <input
                  id="edit-location"
                  type="text"
                  value={values.location}
                  onChange={(e) => handleChange('location', e.target.value)}
                  className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('location') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.section}>
              <div className={styles.sectionHeader}>
                <span className={styles.sectionTitle}>Time &amp; Schedule</span>
                <div className={styles.sectionLine} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <div className={styles.gridRow3}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <div className={styles.fieldHeader}>
                    <label htmlFor="edit-day" className={styles.label}>
                      Day of Week
                    </label>
                    {isFieldChanged('dayOfWeek') && <span className={styles.changedBadge}>Edited</span>}
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="edit-day"
                    type="text"
                    value={values.dayOfWeek}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('dayOfWeek', e.target.value)}
                    className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('dayOfWeek') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <div className={styles.fieldHeader}>
                    <label htmlFor="edit-start" className={styles.label}>
                      Start Time
                    </label>
                    {isFieldChanged('startTime') && <span className={styles.changedBadge}>Edited</span>}
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="edit-start"
                    type="text"
                    value={values.startTime}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('startTime', e.target.value)}
                    className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('startTime') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <div className={styles.fieldHeader}>
                    <label htmlFor="edit-end" className={styles.label}>
                      End Time
                    </label>
                    {isFieldChanged('endTime') && <span className={styles.changedBadge}>Edited</span>}
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="edit-end"
                    type="text"
                    value={values.endTime}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('endTime', e.target.value)}
                    className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('endTime') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className={styles.gridRow}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <div className={styles.fieldHeader}>
                    <label htmlFor="edit-freq" className={styles.label}>
                      Frequency
                    </label>
                    {isFieldChanged('frequency') && <span className={styles.changedBadge}>Edited</span>}
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="edit-freq"
                    type="text"
                    value={values.frequency}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('frequency', e.target.value)}
                    className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('frequency') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <div className={styles.fieldHeader}>
                    <label htmlFor="edit-freq-notes" className={styles.label}>
                      Frequency Notes
                    </label>
                    {isFieldChanged('frequencyNotes') && <span className={styles.changedBadge}>Edited</span>}
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="edit-freq-notes"
                    type="text"
                    value={values.frequencyNotes}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('frequencyNotes', e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="e.g. Even weeks, May-Sep"
                    className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('frequencyNotes') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.section}>
              <div className={styles.sectionHeader}>
                <span className={styles.sectionTitle}>Price &amp; Registration</span>
                <div className={styles.sectionLine} aria-hidden="true" />

                      Price

                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="edit-price"
                    type="text"
                    value={values.price}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('price', e.target.value)}
                    className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('price') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <div className={styles.fieldHeader}>
                    <label htmlFor="edit-prereg" className={styles.label}>
                      Pre-Registration / RSVP
                    </label>
                    {isFieldChanged('preRegistration') && <span className={styles.changedBadge}>Edited</span>}
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="edit-prereg"
                    type="text"
                    value={values.preRegistration}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('preRegistration', e.target.value)}
                    className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('preRegistration') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.section}>
              <div className={styles.sectionHeader}>
                <span className={styles.sectionTitle}>Links &amp; Social</span>
                <div className={styles.sectionLine} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <div className={styles.gridRow}>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <div className={styles.fieldHeader}>
                    <label htmlFor="edit-map" className={styles.label}>
                      Google Maps Link
                    </label>
                    {isFieldChanged('map') && <span className={styles.changedBadge}>Edited</span>}
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="edit-map"
                    type="text"
                    value={values.map}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('map', e.target.value)}
                    className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('map') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className={styles.field}>
                  <div className={styles.fieldHeader}>
                    <label htmlFor="edit-social" className={styles.label}>
                      Instagram / Social Link
                    </label>
                    {isFieldChanged('social') && <span className={styles.changedBadge}>Edited</span>}
                  </div>
                  <input
                    id="edit-social"
                    type="text"
                    value={values.social}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange('social', e.target.value)}
                    className={`${styles.input} ${isFieldChanged('social') ? styles.inputChanged : ''}`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.section}>
              <div className={styles.sectionHeader}>
                <span className={styles.sectionTitle}>Notes &amp; Submitter Info</span>
                <div className={styles.sectionLine} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <label htmlFor="edit-notes" className={styles.label}>
                  What changed or needs updating? (optional context)
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="edit-notes"
                  value={notes}
                  onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Explain reason for changes or provide additional links..."
                  className={styles.textarea}
                />
              </div>
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <label htmlFor="edit-email" className={styles.label}>
                  Your Email (optional)
                </label>
                <input
                  id="edit-email"
                  type="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="name@example.com"
                  className={styles.input}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            {status && (
              <div
                className={`${styles.statusAlert} ${
                  status.success ? styles.statusSuccess : styles.statusError
                }`}
                role="status"
              >
                {status.message}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className={styles.modalFooter}>
            <div
              className={`${styles.changeSummary} ${
                changedFields.length > 0 ? styles.changeSummaryActive : ''
              }`}
            >
              {changedFields.length === 0
                ? notes.trim()
                  ? 'Note only'
                  : 'No changes made yet'
                : `${changedFields.length} field${changedFields.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} modified`}
            </div>
            <div className={styles.modalActions}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={styles.modalCancelBtn}
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className={styles.modalSubmitBtn}
                disabled={isSubmitting || !hasChanges}
              >
                {isSubmitting
                  ? 'Sending...'
                  : changedFields.length > 0
                  ? `Send ${changedFields.length} Edit${changedFields.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
                  : 'Send Edit'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
